derived.method: CalPERS shares ÷ shares outstanding, Class A plus Class B (1,019,990 ÷ (424,579,862 + 162,962,335) = 1,019,990 ÷ 587,542,197)

inputs.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, cover page
inputs.quote: As of October 15, 2026, 424,579,862 shares of the registrant's Class A common stock were outstanding, 162,962,335 shares of the registrant's Class B common stock were outstanding, no shares of the registrant's Class C common stock were outstanding, and 9,200,000 shares of the registrant's Class H common stock were outstanding.

inputs.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, share class rights
inputs.quote: The rights, including the liquidation and dividend rights, of the holders of Class A and Class B common stock are identical, except with respect to voting and conversion.

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 5
source.quote: Class A common stock: 803 stockholders of record. This number does not include stockholders for whom shares were held in "nominee" or "street name." • Class B common stock: 53 stockholders of record.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The denominator is Class A plus Class B from the Q3 2026 10-Q cover (October 15, 2026), the same count used in the marketcap lens; the 9,200,000 Class H shares are excluded because the 10-K says all of them are held by Airbnb's wholly-owned Host Endowment Fund subsidiary. Holders of record (January 31, 2026): listed Class A only; the 10-K also gives 53 holders of record of Class B.
